name: The Mace of the Black Crown

system.description:
Growing Unique (heavy mace +1).

Dormant (when found, save DC 13): +1d6 fire on a hit.

Awakened (bearer 9th level, save DC 15): the mace is +2; once per day, cast summon lesser monster (fiends only).

Exalted (bearer 17th level, save DC 17): the mace is +3; once per day, cast summon monster (fiends only).

Monsters & Treasure, Growing Uniques. Each state adds to the one before. It falls back to Dormant with a new bearer. Its bonus is +1 Dormant, +2 Awakened and +3 Exalted: raise it on the item when it wakes.
